import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation

def kabsch(P,Q):
    # Nx3 source->target
    pc=P.mean(0); qc=Q.mean(0)
    u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    d=np.linalg.det(u@vt)
    R=u@np.diag([1,1,d])@vt
    return R, qc-pc@R

s='C1(C)=C(CC(C(F)(F)F)(C(F)(F)F)O)C(C)=C(C)[C-]1C'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(s))
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=45; params.numThreads=0; params.pruneRmsThresh=0.1
cids=list(AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m,numConfs=250,params=params))
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
ring=[0,2,14,16,18]; Oidx=13
# target cyclic coords arm vertex index2 at azimuth 39 degrees; cyclic ring progresses 72 degrees
ang=np.deg2rad(39)
target=np.zeros((5,3))
for i,idx in enumerate(ring):
 a=ang+np.deg2rad(72*i)
 target[i]=[1.22*np.cos(a),1.22*np.sin(a),1.90]
best=[]
for cid in cids:
 ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m,props,confId=cid); ff.Minimize(maxIts=250)
 conf=m.GetConformer(cid)
 P=np.array(conf.GetPositions())
 R,t=kabsch(P[ring],target)
 P=P@R+t
 o=P[Oidx]
 d=np.linalg.norm(o)
 # score based upon O placement Rh bond near 2.1, plus orientation target (1.6,1.2,0)
 goal=np.array([1.65,1.25,0.15])
 score=np.linalg.norm(o-goal)+.4*abs(d-2.1)+.01*ff.CalcEnergy()
 best.append((score,cid,o,ff.CalcEnergy(),d,P))
best.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
for x in best[:10]: print(x[0],x[1],x[2],x[3],x[4])
# save top transformed coordinates
x=best[0];np.savetxt('/tmp/cpcoords.txt',x[5]);
